claim: Patchline ships a runtime policy monitor proving the agent never violates a declared safety automaton. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the runtime policy monitor claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make runtime-policy-monitor-gate`.
